history.content: i dont really know why im here. someone said this app helps. i just feel kind of nothing lately
“Kind of nothing lately” feels like the clearest thing in the room right now. We can stay with that, or leave it there if you want.
see thats the thing. it just repeats what i said back at me. ok yeah its nothing. its been like 3 weeks where me and my girlfriend sit on the same couch and i feel like im watching it through glass
“Watching it through glass” gives this a very different shape, more detached than calm. Is it more like you feel blank and far away, or more like you’re there but not getting in?
there but not getting in i guess. she asked me last night if everything was ok and i just said yeah fine. i wasnt lying exactly. i just didnt feel anything to report
That sounds less like blankness and more like being cut off from whatever would normally answer her. Did it feel heavy, distant, or just unreachable?

unreachable. and the part that bugs me is im not even upset about it. like i used to actually want to be around her and now i just dont feel the pull. and i cant tell if somethings wrong with us or with me
“Unreachable” and “no pull” feel like the centre of this, and the question underneath is whether this is about the two of you or about you. We can stay with that, or leave it here for now.
yeah. i dont have an answer for that tonight. but its weird saying it out loud. ive been kind of pretending its not a thing
Saying it out loud seems to have made it real in the room. We can leave it there for tonight, or stay with what felt weird about saying it.
lets leave it there. this was less pointless than i expected honestly. thanks
I’m glad it helped a little, and we can leave it right there.
